page.overview:
Who is Bambi?

Bambi was a acrobatic guard tasked by Ernst Blofeld with imprisoning the reclusive billionaire Willard Whyte. Portrayed by actress and singer Lola Larson, the character was created especially for EON Productions' 1971 James Bond film Diamonds Are Forever.

Along with her counterpart Thumper, Bambi was an operative of the criminal organisation SPECTRE. The pair were tasked with guarding the imprisoned billionaire Willard Whyte at his luxury residence in the suburbs of Las Vegas. Highly athletic and trained in hand-to-hand combat, the pair made formidable prison guards, and attempted to murder the inquisitive James Bond during his visit to the property. After a protracted brawl, the women threw him into an outdoor pool. Sensing an opportunity to finish Bond off, they dived in and attempt to drown him; only to have the tables turned on them. 007 held them both underwater until CIA liaison Felix Leiter and his men arrived, presumably taking the pair into custody.

entity.description:
Bambi is a Disney animal figure first to be introduced in 2023.

Bambi is the titular protagonist of Disney's 1942 animated feature film of the same name.

A deer living in a forest, he's best friends with Thumper and Flower. He was closest to his mother, who was shot and killed by a hunter during his first winter. Raised into a strong deer by his father, The Great Prince of the Forest, he falls in love with his childhood sweetheart, Faline, and they have twin fawns.
